title: Cold brew coffee apparatus with recirculating pump
abstract: A cold brew coffee maker circulates water through a bed of coffee grounds with a low power pump to shorten extraction time to under two hours.
claims: A cold brew coffee apparatus comprising a vessel, a filter basket holding coffee grounds, and a pump recirculating chilled water through the filter basket continuously during extraction.

title: Smart water bottle with hydration tracking sensor
abstract: A water bottle includes a level sensor and wireless transmitter that logs fluid intake and reminds the user to drink.
claims: A water bottle comprising a container, a fluid level sensor, a processor computing fluid intake over time, and a wireless transmitter sending intake data to a mobile device.

title: Wearable posture sensor strap
abstract: A strap worn across the upper back detects slouching with an accelerometer and vibrates to cue the wearer.
claims: A wearable posture device comprising an elastic strap, an accelerometer measuring spinal angle, and a vibration motor activated when the angle exceeds a threshold.

title: Espresso machine with pressure profiling
abstract: An espresso machine varies brewing pressure during extraction according to a programmable profile using a variable speed pump.
claims: An espresso machine comprising a boiler, a variable speed pump, a group head, and a controller adjusting pump speed to follow a stored pressure profile during extraction.

title: Resistance band with integrated force sensor
abstract: An exercise band embeds a strain sensor that reports applied tension to a display.
claims: An exercise device comprising an elastic resistance band, a strain gauge embedded along the band, and a display showing tension measured by the strain gauge.

title: Self-stirring mug with magnetic base
abstract: A mug with a magnetic stirrer in the base stirs a beverage when set on a powered coaster.
claims: A self-stirring mug comprising a vessel, a rotatable magnetic stirrer in the vessel base, and a powered coaster with a rotating magnet driving the stirrer.

title: Cold brew coffee apparatus with ultrasonic extraction
abstract: A cold brew system applies ultrasonic transducers to a coffee slurry to extract flavor in minutes.
claims: A cold brew coffee system comprising a vessel holding coffee grounds in chilled water, and an ultrasonic transducer coupled to the vessel that excites the slurry during extraction.

title: Smart bottle with hydration reminder and companion app
abstract: A bottle with a lid sensor and capacitive level sensor sends intake data to an app that schedules reminders.
claims: A smart bottle comprising a container, a capacitive fluid level sensor, a lid sensor, a wireless transmitter, and a mobile application that schedules hydration reminders based on measured intake.

title: Wearable posture correction with haptic feedback
abstract: A back-worn module measures spine inclination with an inertial sensor and gives graded haptic cues.
claims: A posture correction wearable comprising an inertial measurement unit measuring spinal inclination, a haptic actuator, and a processor producing graded vibration intensity as inclination increases.

title: Smart jump rope with revolution counting
abstract: A jump rope handle embeds a magnetic sensor to count revolutions and send workout data over Bluetooth.
claims: A jump rope comprising a rope, handles, a magnetic sensor in a handle counting rotations of the rope, and a Bluetooth module transmitting the count to a mobile device.

title: Portable USB rechargeable blender
abstract: A compact blender with a rechargeable battery and USB charging port blends single servings away from a power outlet.
claims: A portable blender comprising a cup, a blade assembly, a motor, a rechargeable battery within the base, and a USB charging port for charging the battery.

title: Portable blender with self-cleaning cycle
abstract: A battery powered blender runs a rinse cycle with a water fill line and pulsing motor to clean the blade assembly.
claims: A portable blender comprising a cup, a battery powered motor, a blade assembly, and a controller executing a self-cleaning cycle that pulses the motor when the cup contains water to a fill line.

title: Smartwatch with fall detection
abstract: A wristwatch detects falls from accelerometer signatures and contacts an emergency number.
claims: A smartwatch comprising an accelerometer, a processor classifying a fall from an acceleration signature, and a cellular module contacting an emergency number upon detected fall.

title: Watch with e-ink display
abstract: A watch uses an electrophoretic display to show time with near zero power use.
claims: A watch comprising a case, a movement, and an electrophoretic display showing time, wherein the display is refreshed only when the displayed time changes.

title: Yoga mat with pressure sensing array
abstract: A yoga mat embeds a grid of pressure sensors and shows weight distribution to guide alignment.
claims: A yoga mat comprising a flexible mat body, an array of pressure sensors embedded across the mat body, and a processor producing a weight distribution map for display to the user.

title: Induction milk frother
abstract: A milk frother heats and whips milk with an induction coil and a magnetically coupled whisk.
claims: A milk frother comprising a jug, an induction coil heating the jug, and a whisk magnetically coupled to a drive in the base that rotates to froth milk.
